My questions are 1)if a person perform any salah i,e, fard, sunah, wajb or nafil, in masjib or home. In the state of janabah(imputities),(a) when he knew about fiqh of janbah and (b) when he did not knew the fiqh of janabah, what he do after prfomed salah in both contidtion and after performed that salah,he read rules of Janabah. 2)When a person perform EID and Jumah salah in masjid, in the state of Janabah (impunities) (a) when he knew about fiqh of janbah and (b) when he did not knew the fiqh of janabah, what he do after prfomed salah in both contidtion and after performed that salah,he read rules of Janabah. Answer ID: 14873 Posted on: Sep 1, 2020 Bismillah hir-Rahman nir-Rahim ! (Fatwa: 1236/1236=M/1430) Performing salah in the state of janabah (seminal impurity) is unlawful, the salah will be invalid whichever salah it may be, whether performed at home or in mosque. If someone knows he is impure while he is aware of the Islamic ruling as well, he is feared to commit kufr. He must seek forgiveness from Allah and repent to Him. The fardh and wajib salah performed in this state should compulsorily be repeated. If someone performed salah in the state of janabah forgetfully or unintentionally he should repeat the fardh and wajib salah after he comes to know the same. There is no qadha of Eid Salah and in the place of Jumu?ah Salah four rak?ah of Zuhr will be performed Allah (Subhana Wa Ta'ala) knows Best Darul Ifta, Darul Uloom Deoband, India
